gauge.name: Big Sandy River (WY) above Big Sandy Reservoir

impacts.statement: Major Flood Stage. Flood Plain Full. Left Bank likely seeing significant errosion.
Moderate Flood Stage. Water Tops embankment by 1 ft. Gage equipment likely damaged or destroyed and embankment likely compromised.
Minor Flood Stage. Top of embankment.
Bankfull stage. Action Stage. Water reaches the top of staff gage on left bank flume structure.
